what: Two of fifteen mutants had a find string that was not in the file. A cheap-tier job wrote mutants from diffs; two multi-line `find` blocks carried the wrong indentation and matched nothing, caught only because the coordinator counted each by hand.
rule: Count every mutant's find in its target before a mutants run.
fix: Enforcement: `mutants` and `integrate --mutants` refuse the whole run before any check or write, listing each `invalid-find` / `ambiguous-find` / `no-op` mutant; `mutants --dry-run` does only that. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-e.test.mjs`.
